description: Image Description: The image shows a close-up view of two skis lying on a snowy surface. The skis are positioned diagonally, with their tips pointing toward the upper part of the frame and their tails extending downward. The snow appears smooth and undisturbed except for faint tracks or grooves running parallel to the skis, possibly from previous movement. The ski on the left has a predominantly red design with white and black accents, featuring a visible logo or graphic that includes a star-like symbol
